fence.statement: theorem quadratic_geometry (x y : E) : HasGradientAt (fun z : E => ‖z‖ ^ 2 / 2) y y ∧ divergence (fun z : E => ‖z‖ ^ 2 / 2) x y = ‖x - y‖ ^ 2 / 2

theorem euclidean_variable_regret (V : Set E) (hV : Convex ℝ V) (hVn : V.Nonempty) (hVc : IsClosed V) (η : ℕ → ℝ) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x0 : E) (x : ℕ → E) (T : ℕ) (hT : 0 < T) (hη : ∀ t < T, 0 < η t) (hinit : x 0 = x0) (hmono : ∀ t, t + 1 < T → η (t + 1) ≤ η t) (hbot : ∀ t < T, ∀ z, loss t z ≠ ⊥) (hdom : ∀ t < T, V ⊆ BanditRL.OnlineConvex.effectiveDomain (loss t)) (hs : ∀ t < T, ∀ z ∈ V, (BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceSubdifferential (loss t) z).Nonempty) (hmin : ∀ t < T, x (t + 1) ∈ V ∧ IsMinOn (fun z => loss t z + ((‖z - x t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η t) : ℝ) : EReal)) V (x (t + 1))) (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V) : (∀ t ≤ T, iterate V (fun z : E => ‖z‖ ^ 2 / 2) η loss x0 t = some (x t)) ∧ (∑ t ∈ range T, ((loss t (x (t + 1))).toReal - (loss t u).toReal)) ≤ ((range T).sup' (nonempty_range_iff.mpr (Nat.ne_of_gt hT)) (fun t => ‖u - x t‖ ^ 2 / 2)) / η (T - 1) - ∑ t ∈ range T, ‖x (t + 1) - x t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η t)

theorem euclidean_fixed_regret (V : Set E) (hV : Convex ℝ V) (hVn : V.Nonempty) (hVc : IsClosed V) (η : ℝ) (hη : 0 < η) (loss : ℕ → E → EReal) (x0 : E) (x : ℕ → E) (T : ℕ) (hinit : x 0 = x0) (hbot : ∀ t < T, ∀ z, loss t z ≠ ⊥) (hdom : ∀ t < T, V ⊆ BanditRL.OnlineConvex.effectiveDomain (loss t)) (hs : ∀ t < T, ∀ z ∈ V, (BanditRL.OnlineConvex.SourceSubdifferential (loss t) z).Nonempty) (hmin : ∀ t < T, x (t + 1) ∈ V ∧ IsMinOn (fun z => loss t z + ((‖z - x t‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η) : ℝ) : EReal)) V (x (t + 1))) (u : E) (hu : u ∈ V) : (∀ t ≤ T, iterate V (fun z : E => ‖z‖ ^ 2 / 2) (fun _ => η) loss x0 t = some (x t)) ∧ (∑ t ∈ range T, ((loss t (x (t + 1))).toReal - (loss t u).toReal)) ≤ ‖u - x0‖ ^ 2 / (2 * η) - (∑ t ∈ range T, ‖x (t + 1) - x t‖ ^ 2) / (2 * η)
